name: Extended Clip Crit
notes: i.e. if you have a rifle with 45 bullets in the chamber the first shot does +88% crit damage if it crits, the next shot does +86% etc. with duel pistols, each one is counted individually, so a 15 clip glock's first shot does +28% crit damage. The bonus weapons are affected too
summary: Each remaining bullet in a magazine increases the crit damage by 2%. Increases the magazine size.
